svg.title: The Mackenzie Building of the Royal Military College of Canada on Point Frederick, Kingston, square on, drawn to the measured proportions of the 2007 elevation photograph: a long, low, symmetrical block of grey limestone, two storeys over a basement row of small windows, with FIVE plain bays in each wing under a weathered-green mansard band carrying a row of dark hooded arched dormers; at each end a taller pavilion with paired windows, an attic storey of paired arched windows and a steep green mansard with a round oculus and a flat cap; and in the centre a tall, slender stone tower rising in stages from a small arched door (no steps, no portico) through paired windows and a louvred belfry stage to a steep dark slate roof with a round face in it, two small lunette dormers and a flat top with iron cresting. The round face in the tower roof is drawn plain, without hands, the same round form as the pavilion oculi. THE COLLEGE'S OWN FLAG flies from a flagstaff on the tower's flat top, where both reference photographs show the staff (amendment to Ruling 2, 2026-09-26; the guide, p. 79, ties the red-white-red pattern to this flag). The flag is THE OFFICIAL ARTWORK, not a simplification: the Commons SVG of the 1920 flag (Artist of the College of Arms; SVG by Christopher Boucher, 2020; public domain in Canada) imported path for path, not redrawn - a vertical red-white-red tricolour in three EQUAL bands at 3:2 with the college's full arms in the white band: the royal crown, the armoured arm holding three maple leaves, the red-and-white wreath and the bilingual motto scroll, in the official colours exactly (palette.json insignia-rmc ramps). The only changes are a gentle wave (a smooth vertical sine warp of every point, zero at the hoist) and the removal of a 0.6-unit gap under the white band in the Commons file. The Commons file marks it a prohibited mark (Trademarks Act s. 9(1)(n)(i)). It is not the National Flag: no single red maple leaf, no 1:2:1 bands. The staff is the measured length (0.234 of the building's width above the tower cap); the flag is drawn 210 x 140, about six times its photographed size, so the arms are recognisable at play size (art-bible section 5 rule 2). Otherwise BUILDINGS ONLY: no cadet or figure of any kind, no crest, badge, coat of arms or carved device on the building (the carving over the door and in the tower's arched hood is left as plain stone), no memorial arch, no lettering. Drawn from assets/refs/kingston/rmc-mackenzie-building-elevation-2007.jpg (a night exposure, used for geometry only), with roof colours from rmc-mackenzie-building-daylight-2008.jpg and the flag imported from the Commons SVG that rmc-college-flag-2020.jpg was rasterised from. Every colour is from palette.json. See assets/refs/references.json, subject royal-military-college. POI hero, present at every visual tier.
